_doc: Host -> capability map for Fleet Work Placement Phase 1 (card t_8c474c2e; spec Obsidian 'AI/Infrastructure/Fleet Work Placement -- Host Affinity and Continuation (spec, 2026-10-11).md' v2 s1.2, s1.3, s2.3). Hand-written for Phase 1; Phase 2 (fleet-host capabilities --sync/--set) takes ownership. Every body-sniff term lives here (F13), none in code. A pool host with no row has no capability. Absent file = feature off. Malformed = every capability warn for the tick, pool never refused (F11). Modes: kanban.placement.capabilities off|warn|enforce + capabilities_enforce (default browser-session, screen) in the ROOT config.yaml.

browser-session.what: Ace's signed-in browser profiles over CDP on the Studio (:9222 shared Brave, :9223, :9224 shopping), with his cookies

screen.what: an unlocked GUI session to click, type and screenshot (peekaboo, cua-driver, macOS Accessibility)

imessage.what: Messages.app / chat.db / imsg, incl. reading 2FA codes

op-desktop.what: 1Password desktop app integration (biometric unlock, personal vault); not the service-account op CLI every host has

apple-apps.what: Notes, Reminders, FindMy, AppleScript into Ace's apps

control-plane.what: the live runtime tree, gateway launchd jobs, ~/.hermes/config.yaml (the six studio_bound_skills harness skills)

acoustic-bench.what: the Mac-side voice acceptance rig (acceptance.sh from the Mac, afplay, bench satellite)
